title: Newsroom board on phones: adopt the stacked Kanbus layout
description:
The horizontal board does not work on phones. Kanbus is adding a stacked layout to @kanbus/ui (Kanbus epic kbs-c2a93c, released as ui-v0.5.0 under kbs-069530): below 600 px, status columns become sections in one vertical column. Phones in landscape and tablets keep the horizontal board. This task adopts it in the newsroom. Blocked until ui-v0.5.0 is published.

Work:
1. Bump @kanbus/ui in package.json from ui-v0.4.1 to ui-v0.5.0.
2. Replace the .kb-column-scroll scroll sniffing in components/newsroom-board-view.tsx (loadMoreWhenColumnIsNearItsEnd, handleBoardScroll and its effect) with the new onColumnNearEnd callback, or stage paging stops on phones.
3. Remove the phone column-width workaround in components/newsroom-organizer.css (.organizer-native-board .kb-column min-width, under max-width 640px), and keep the card wrapping rules if they are still needed.
4. Check that the scroller fits the shell: the 55 px top bar, the bottom navigation and the safe area, with no nested or double scrolling (.organizer-main overflow hidden, .kb-issue-collection overflow auto).
5. Make NewsroomBoardSkeleton match the stacked layout on phones so loading does not flash columns.
6. Check IssueTypeFilter and the Board/List toggle at 375 px.

Acceptance, on real newsroom pages at 375 and 390 px, plus 834 and 1440 px to confirm columns are unchanged:
- Articles, desk and assignments boards render as sections with no horizontal scroll, in all four editorial themes, light and dark.
- Long stages page in as the reader scrolls.
- Opening a card shows the detail overlay; closing it returns to the same card and scroll position.
- Collapsed sections persist.
- scripts/test-newsroom-board-theme.cjs and scripts/test-newsroom-ux-review.ts extended for the stacked layout and passing.
- Checked on a real phone.

Related: PPY-fb6ab4 (phone detail sheet covers the full screen) and PPY-e62d13 (ops IA as a mobile app).

Checked locally: typecheck, scripts/test-newsroom-board-theme.cjs, and scripts/test-newsroom-ux-review.ts at 9 of 9 scenarios and 40 of 40 steps; preview pages at 120 of 120 combinations of theme, mode and width, taken before the bump from 0.5.0 to 0.5.1; title wrapping at 667 by 375 in a screenshot. CI on 7a0051f6 passed except python, which failed one unrelated test, test_build_concept_authority_records_materializes_counts_and_rank, already failing on develop after 69b711f9 renamed the function. Merged with that failure on Ryan's instruction. Not checked: a real phone, the safe-area inset, and long-stage paging on real data (fixture only).
